Version: 2.4

Install the CLI

The CLI installs with any Node package manager.

  • npm
  • Yarn
npm install --global example-kit
yarn global add example-kit
Never run it as root

It writes to your home directory only.

Configure​

kit.config.js
export default {
	out: "dist",
};

Try it​

Live Editor
function Hello() {
  return <b>Hello</b>;
}
Result
Hello
